# immich_users (Data Source)

Fetches the list of users.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "immich_users" "users" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `users` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users))

<a id="nestedatt--users"></a>
### Nested Schema for `users`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) The date when the user was created.
- `deleted_at` (String) The date when the user was deleted.
- `email` (String) The user's email address.
- `id` (String) User Id.
- `is_admin` (Boolean) If true, the user is an administrator.
- `name` (String) The name of the user.
- `status` (String) The user's status.
- `updated_at` (String) The date when the user was last modified.
